description: A decorative panel that rains particles down the rack, with no outputs of any kind

params.text: Picks the particle: Snowflake, Raindrop, Acid Rain, Leaf, Petal, Ash, Ember, Star, Meteor, Bubble, Confetti, Polka Dots, Heart and three more
Sets how large the particles are drawn
Sets how fast the particles fall
Sets how many particles are on screen at once
Angles the fall away from straight down

inputs.text: Adds to the number of particles
Adds to the angle of fall
A voltage here starts and stops the fall

notes: This module has no output jacks and makes no sound: everything it does is drawn on the screen.
menu: Mouse Tracker — makes the particles follow the mouse pointer
Particle Opacity — a slider setting how solid the particles are drawn
